checks.description: Azure Storage accounts must disable anonymous public blob access
checks.impact: Enabling public blob access exposes storage container contents to the internet without authentication, risking data exfiltration
checks.resolution: Set allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false on the azurerm_storage_account resource (AzureRM provider v3+). For older providers use allow_blob_public_access = false
checks.errorMessage: Azure Storage account has public blob access enabled (allow_nested_items_to_be_public must be false)
